definitions.explanation: Being outdoors without a roof or covering. Often used as a modifier to describe outdoor baths, mining operations, or other activities done under the open sky.

examples.japanese: {露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ}に{入|はい}る。
この{旅館|りょかん}は{露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ}{付|つ}きの{部屋|へや}がある。
examples.english: This inn has rooms with private outdoor baths.

examples.japanese: {星空|ほしぞら}の{下|した}で{露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ}に{浸|つ}かるのは{格別|かくべつ}な{気持|きも}ちだ。
examples.english: Soaking in an outdoor bath under a starry sky is an exceptional feeling.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ} (open-air bath), a major attraction at Japanese hot springs ({温泉|おんせん}) and inns ({旅館|りょかん}).

Do not confuse with the homophone {露店|ろてん} (street stall/vendor), which uses a different kanji for the second character ({店|てん} = shop vs {天|てん} = sky/heaven).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ} (open-air bath)
- {露天|ろてん}{掘|ぼ}り (open-pit mining)
- {露天|ろてん}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう} (open-air parking lot)
